votes (table)
- Id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- PostId: INTEGER
- VoteTypeId: INTEGER
- CreationDate: DATE
- UserId: INTEGER
- BountyAmount: INTEGER
PRIMARY KEY (Id)
FOREIGN KEY (PostId) REFERENCES posts (Id)
FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES users (Id)

arguments.sql:
SELECT v.VoteTypeId, typeof(v.BountyAmount) AS amount_type, MIN(v.CreationDate) AS first_date, MAX(v.CreationDate) AS last_date, typeof(p.OwnerUserId) AS owner_type, COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(p.Id) AS matched_posts, COUNT(NULLIF(p.OwnerDisplayName, '')) AS with_name
FROM main.votes AS v
LEFT JOIN main.posts AS p ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE v.BountyAmount >= 30
  AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
GROUP BY v.VoteTypeId, typeof(v.BountyAmount), typeof(p.OwnerUserId)
